"PROJECT – WILD WEST ZOMBIES

I want you to develop a high-quality, professional Roblox survival game called WILD WEST ZOMBIES using Roblox Studio and Luau.

The game takes place in the year 1899, in a dangerous Wild West world that has been overrun by a mysterious zombie outbreak.

Players take the role of cowboy survivors who must fight zombies, collect coins, upgrade weapons, unlock new locations, defeat powerful bosses, ride horses, complete missions, and survive together with other players.

The goal is to create an immersive, addictive, multiplayer survival experience with rewarding progression and high replayability.

1. CORE GAMEPLAY

Create a complete gameplay system where players can:

- Fight zombies using different Wild West weapons.
- Earn coins and XP by defeating enemies.
- Purchase new weapons and upgrade existing ones.
- Unlock new maps and dangerous regions.
- Collect rare equipment and cosmetic rewards.
- Open treasure chests for valuable items.
- Complete daily and weekly missions.
- Ride and customize horses.
- Play solo or cooperate with friends.
- Participate in boss fights and endless survival waves.

Every activity should provide meaningful rewards and progression.

2. WORLD AND MAP DESIGN

Create six unique locations:

1. Dusty Town – An abandoned Wild West town with saloons, wooden buildings, and infected survivors.
2. Cursed Cemetery – A terrifying graveyard filled with undead creatures and hidden secrets.
3. Desert Outpost – A dangerous desert settlement surrounded by sandstorms.
4. Abandoned Mine – A dark underground mining facility containing rare treasures and powerful enemies.
5. Ghost Train Station – An abandoned railway station featuring a mysterious haunted train.
6. Deadwood City – A massive infected city containing the strongest zombies and legendary bosses.

Each location must have unique enemies, missions, rewards, environmental details, and boss encounters.

Players should unlock new locations through progression.

3. ZOMBIE AI AND BOSS SYSTEM

Implement different zombie types:

- Normal Zombie
- Runner Zombie
- Armored Zombie
- Explosive Zombie
- Giant Zombie
- Legendary Boss Zombie

Each enemy must have unique health, damage, movement speed, attack patterns, animations, and sounds.

Bosses must feature multiple attack phases, special abilities, unique animations, and exclusive rewards.

Create intelligent zombie AI that can detect, chase, attack, and target players.

4. WEAPON SYSTEM

Add authentic Wild West weapons:

- Revolver
- Winchester Rifle
- Shotgun
- Double-Barrel Shotgun
- Sniper Rifle
- Gatling Gun

Each weapon must have different damage, fire rate, reload speed, magazine capacity, range, and rarity.

Weapon rarity levels:

- Common
- Uncommon
- Rare
- Epic
- Legendary
- Mythical

Implement weapon purchasing, upgrading, ammunition, inventory management, reload animations, shooting effects, and satisfying hit feedback.

5. SURVIVAL AND WAVE MODE

Create an endless Zombie Survival Mode.

- Zombies become stronger with every wave.
- Enemy numbers increase progressively.
- Special enemies appear in later waves.
- Powerful bosses appear at specific wave intervals.
- Players receive better rewards for surviving longer.
- Support both solo and multiplayer survival.
- Include global survival leaderboards.

Make every wave challenging and rewarding.

6. PLAYER PROGRESSION AND ECONOMY

Implement a complete progression system:

- Coins and XP.
- Player levels.
- Weapon upgrades.
- Player inventory.
- Daily login rewards.
- Daily and weekly missions.
- Achievements and badges.
- Prestige system.
- Global leaderboards.
- Unlockable titles.
- Cowboy outfits, hats, boots, and accessories.
- Exclusive boss rewards.

All player progress must be saved reliably using Roblox DataStoreService.

7. HORSE SYSTEM

Create a complete horse system.

Players should be able to:

- Purchase different horse breeds.
- Summon their horses.
- Mount and dismount.
- Ride across the map.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
